paragraphs: Benefit payments are based on the amount of the provider's charge that Blue Cross and/or Blue Shield plans recognize for payment of benefits.

paragraphs: Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Alabama's Dental Network is a statewide dental network.
This managed care program is designed to promote quality and cost effective dental care.
Currently more than 2,800 dentists, approximately 93% of the dentists in Alabama, have joined this program.
It is my pleasure to offer this introduction to the Staff Handbook for the University of North Alabama. This is an important document.
As a member of the UNA family, is important that you have easy access to up-to-date information regarding policies, responsibilities, and benefits that relate to your employment.
We all take pride in the strong system of shared governance that exists at UNA. But shared governance can never be taken for granted.
